base.text:
Can be sold from your hand at the Marketplace.
Discover a Stinkyscape card.

radiant.text:
Can be sold from your hand at the Marketplace.
Discover a Radiant Stinkyscape card.

base.text: Cry: Discard your hand. Fill your hand with random Stinkyscape Resources.

radiant.text: Cry: Discard your hand. Fill your hand with random Radiant Stinkyscape Resources.

base.text: One random effect: Replace your side of the field with a random Anomaly, any of the ten; summon 3 Drone Corvettes; summon the Drone Battleship; cast 2 different cards of Core System, Secure System, Unsecure System and Wild System, picked at random; add 4 random Starship Pieces to your hand, which cost (0); summon a Drone Interceptor into each of your unit zones, on top of any Unit there; fuse 4 random Starship Pieces into your Dormant Starship, then launch it; add 2 random Radiant Weapons to your hand, which cost (0); for the rest of the game, the Marketplace offers you a Call to Chaos for 20 Credits each turn; cast a random Call to Chaos.

radiant.text: Three different random effects, resolved in the order listed: Replace your side of the field with a random Anomaly, any of the ten; summon 3 Drone Corvettes; summon the Drone Battleship; cast 2 different cards of Core System, Secure System, Unsecure System and Wild System, picked at random; add 4 random Starship Pieces to your hand, which cost (0); summon a Drone Interceptor into each of your unit zones, on top of any Unit there; fuse 4 random Starship Pieces into your Dormant Starship, then launch it; add 2 random Radiant Weapons to your hand, which cost (0); for the rest of the game, the Marketplace offers you a Call to Chaos for 20 Credits each turn; cast a random Call to Chaos.
